label: Local axioms 5 and 4 at the selected world give axiom 5 at its successors
meaning: Frame-theoretic locator for the dialectical value of Euclidean access at the actual world (F2'), not a route step. Checked: Euclidean access and transitivity at w give Euclidean access at every successor of w. Unverified prose: transitivity at w makes the successor set closed, so the subframe generated by w is Euclidean; hence a view accepting F2' but rejecting global Euclidean access must deny local axiom 4 at w or reject Euclidean access only at worlds w cannot reach (exhaustive, not exclusive). Only the first yields a difference in modal truth at w; globally stated spine premises still commit the bundle about unreachable worlds. No premise is established; both are OPEN frame conditions.
